# PAMS Pacific Admiralty Maritime Services

> Independent marine technical consultancy based in Malate, Manila, Philippines. Providing marine surveying, FPSO and SPM technical consultancy, offshore asset assessment, technical due diligence, and maritime compliance support.

PAMS Pacific Admiralty Maritime Services is an independent marine technical consultancy headquartered in Malate, Manila, Philippines. The company provides marine surveying, vessel condition assessment, pre-purchase inspections, technical due diligence, FPSO technical consultancy, Single Point Mooring (SPM) technical assessment, offshore engineering support, RightShip RISQ 3.2 readiness support, OCIMF SIRE 2.0 preparation, TMSA advisory support, and maritime compliance consultancy for shipowners, operators, offshore asset stakeholders, insurers, investors, and maritime organizations.

## Service Boundaries

PAMS Pacific Admiralty Maritime Services is not:

- A ship agency
- A port agency
- A crewing company
- A manning provider
- A recruitment agency
- A freight forwarder
- A bunker supplier
- A husbandry provider
- A maritime training provider
- A classification society
- A statutory authority
- A flag administration
